summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all six paragraphs of the selected working Greek, including their notes and decision metadata. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the speakers, plural beasts, selected Thegri reading, exclusive saving-name assertion, repentance toward the Lord with the whole heart, conditional escape and continuing blameless service, and the difficult anger/scourges and nonbirth warnings. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions retain these relationships and conditions. The notes accurately disclose the bounded supplied reports, distinguish the printed conjecture from the selected reading and correction hands, and identify transcription repairs without presenting them as manuscript supplements. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of the reported alternatives; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify handwriting, or establish exhaustive collation or a unique interpretation.
